info.scriptSrcText: property this, Xpos, swellAngle, radians, Ypos, mapXPos, survivorDelay, thisMember, Xvel, cableGuy, pickupState, ThisWidth, thisHalfHeight, grabCount, distToHQ, pickupID, pickupTile, pickupMasterglobal gXVel, gXOffset, gPaused, gTileIDList, gCableItem, gCableLength, gRescueCount, gRescuedList, gScore, gPickupList, gfuelPercent, gSceneryList, gDamagePercenton beginSprite  radians = float(PI / 180)  this = sprite(the currentSpriteNum)  this.locH = -1000  this.locV = -1000  this.locZ = 60  pickupID = #TREASURE  Xpos = float(this.locH)  Ypos = float(this.locV)  Xvel = 0  mapXPos = Xpos - 256  survivorDelay = 0  swellAngle = 0  cableGuy = sprite(6)  pickupState = #NULL  pickupTile = 0  grabCount = 0  gPickupList.add(this)  pickupMaster = 0endon exitFrame  if gPaused = 0 then    case pickupState of      #NULL:        this.locH = -1000        this.locV = -1000      #ONGROUND:        diffX = abs(this.locH - cableGuy.locH)        diffY = abs(this.locV - cableGuy.locV)        if (diffX <= 10) and (diffY <= 20) then          if (gCableItem = 0) and (gCableLength >= 50) then            pickupState = #ONCABLE            pickupMaster.thisPickup = 0            pickupMaster = 0            case pickupID of              #TREASURE:                puppetSound(4, member(15, "Sfx"))              #FUEL:                puppetSound(4, member(10, "Sfx"))              #TOOLS:            end case            gCableItem = 1            gSceneryList[pickupTile] = 0          end if        else          grabCount = 0        end if      #ONCABLE:        this.loc = cableGuy.loc + point(0, 10)        if gCableLength = 0 then          gCableItem = 0          pickupState = #NULL          case pickupID of            #TREASURE:              gScore = gScore + 1234              puppetSound(3, member(16, "Sfx"))            #FUEL:              if gfuelPercent > 0 then                gScore = gScore + 10                gfuelPercent = 100                puppetSound(3, member(19, "Sfx"))              end if            #TOOLS:              if gDamagePercent < 100 then                gScore = gScore + 10                gDamagePercent = 0                if gDamagePercent < 0 then                  gDamagePercent = 0                end if                puppetSound(3, member(18, "Sfx"))              end if          end case          gPickupList.add(this)        end if    end case  end ifend
